notes.title: version 0.6 update
notes.content:
Are you ready for multiplayer? 
All new games automagically start in multiplayer mode where everybody plays in the same server. More (multiplayer) functionalities will be put in future updates. 

Some of you didn't like our music choice, so now you can adjust the music volume!  :)
And we've put alot of effort into the keyboard and mouse settings. 

What's added this update?
* internet multiplayer
* multiplayer name above drone
* remapple controles for keyboard and mouse
* mouse sensitivity and smoothness
* audio settings
* forest map is updated a bit

Please vote on [url=https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator]Trello[/url] for the features you want to be developed first in the next version!

notes.title: version 0.5 update
notes.content:
We have listenend to your wishes and updated the factory and freeride, added different drone types, so it's easier for some to fly and updated sounds/music. Happy flying and as always, check our Trello page and vote for the tasks you want to get adressed by us. https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator

version 0.5
[list]
    [*]you can choose three different difficulties (beginner, intermediate and professional). All thee with other control pre-sets (autolevel, throttle, camera, etc)
    [*]in the factory all colliders are done. No more flying through a ceiling and such. Try flying through the hallway and doors! 
    [*]added fpv flags and gates in the factory
    [*]added some more geometrical obstacles to fly around in freeride world 
    [*]improved sound of the drone
    [*]turn upright now keeps your old orientation
    [*]added / updated logo's and icons
    [*]and many small things you might notice :)
[/list]

notes.title: version 0.4 update
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]menu added to select a world, pause the game, quit the game, restart the game and get to see a help page. 
    [*]new world added; abandoned factory! This world will be updated in future versions.
    [*]removed the mouse cursor out of the game while flying. 
    [*]a 20% faster decend (gravity) when you have 0 throttle
    [*]tilted the camera a bit. 
    [*]improved drone controls
    [*]some minor improvements
[/list]

As always, check our Trello page and vote for the tasks you want to get adressed by us. https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator
